steps.action: Immediately remove the changed MCP tool description from all agent contexts that can access the “tickets” MCP server.
steps.quote: Remove the suspicious document or tool from every agent's context.

steps.action: Preserve the changed description, the previously approved description, and their fingerprints for investigation evidence.
steps.quote: Keep a copy of the suspicious content and its fingerprint for the investigation.

steps.action: Enforce fingerprint pinning for approved MCP tool descriptions and block the modified “tickets” tool description.
steps.quote: Pin the descriptions of approved MCP tools by their fingerprint and refuse any modified description.

steps.action: Contact the owner of the “tickets” MCP server to validate the description before restoring it to service.
steps.quote: Ask the source's owner to check the content before it is put back in service.
